free_tier_limits.correction: Fully free; no documented paid plans. Rate limits are not published as a fixed 1000 req/hour — see rate_limits.

rate_limits.correction: Not publicly documented as a fixed 1000 requests/hour. Official FAQ states abusive/high-volume use may be rate-limited and users should contact osv-discuss@googlegroups.com for high volume; no published numerical free-tier quota found on official docs.

description.correction: Remove or soften the claim of 'published rate limits' — official docs do not publish a fixed numerical rate limit for unauthenticated use; high-volume/abusive use may be limited and contact is suggested for heavy use.

notes: base_url, docs, auth (none), free access, and /v1/query example match official OSV docs. The main failure is invented numerical rate limits (1000/hour) and 'higher limits via contact' framing that overstates what official sources publish; FAQ only discusses high-volume contact and possible rate limiting of abuse.
